description: Get details of a specific past conversation. For short conversations (<5K tokens), returns the full transcript. For longer conversations, returns an AI-generated summary. Use when the user wants to dive deeper into a conversation returned by recall_chat_history. Requires the conversationId from that tool's sources array.

conversationId.description: Conversation ID from the recall_chat_history sources array

name: get_conversation_summary
title: Get conversation summary
